AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Basic Maintenance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Basic Maintenance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Basic Maintenance.

2. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cargo Handling.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cargo Handling.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cargo Handling.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cargo Handling.

3. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. When learning Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Unmanned Aircraft System.

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Speaker
   C. Monitor
   D. CPU

8. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.

9. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

10. When learning Aircraft Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Systems.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.

11. When learning Career Opportunities in Aviation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

12. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Stability and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
